# Compatibility Matrices

Source: <https://www.extremenetworks.com/support/compatibility-matrices>

- VOSS, Fabric Engine, and VSP8600

- ERS (Stackable) Switches

- XCO (EFA), SLX-OS, NOS, and NetIron

### Extreme Optics Support

Optics support information for all products is now found on the Extreme Optics site. For tips on using the Extreme Optics site, see the Quick Start Guide on the Optics website.

ExtremeCloud IQ - Site Engine Release Recommendation

We recommend ExtremeCloud IQ - Site Engine version 26.02.13 This recommendation is as of July 2026.

Note: When deploying any software release, customers should always review the Release Notes for known issues that pertain to features and technologies used in their network. Upgrades above these recommendations are suggested only to fix a specific known issue or to implement a required ExtremeCloud IQ - Site Engine feature not included in the currently recommended release or to address security vulnerabilities.
